record.one_liner: Reducto is an API and visual Studio platform that parses, extracts structured data from, splits, classifies and edits PDFs and other documents for AI pipelines.
record.auth_notes: API key created in Studio (studio.reducto.ai/api-keys) and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY'. No OAuth flow for third-party apps found. The local MCP server also supports a browser device-code login that saves a key locally.
record.access_notes: Pricing page: Standard plan is "free to start" with $150 free usage, then pay-as-you-go. Sign up via Studio and create a key. The pricing page's FAQ on key access and credit eligibility was blank. A search snippet said the key-creation role may be limited to Owners; I did not verify that on a fetched page. Rate limits on Standard: 500 concurrent pages (r-1) and 50 (r-1 mini), column mapping inferred.
record.blocker: none. Minor: free credits are limited ($150), the base URL was only seen in a cURL example (platform.reducto.ai), and key-creation permissions are unverified.

evidence.auth: https://docs.reducto.ai/quickstart — Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY; key created in Studio API Keys
evidence.access: https://reducto.ai/pricing — Standard plan free to start with $150 in free usage; Parse/Extract/Edit/Split included
